summary: Bone Biologics Corp filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of pre-funded warrants and Series F/G warrants to purchase up to ~6.3 million shares of common stock. The combined purchase price is $1.419 per pre-funded warrant unit, with Series F/G warrants having an exercise price of $1.42 per share and contingent on stockholder approval. This is a routine capital-raising transaction to fund operations, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium is involved. The offering is a financing event, not a change of control, going-private, or strategic review. The filing does not trigger any special-situation category beyond ordinary financing. What to watch: stockholder vote on warrant issuance and subsequent registration statement effectiveness.
